# Calder Youth Strings

A youth orchestra of about 34 players aged 9 to 17. We rehearse on Sunday afternoons from 2 to 5 pm in term time, and from September we need a new room.

## Rules the committee has set

- The grant pays for the room up to £60 a rehearsal. Anything above that would have to come from members' families, and we promised them it would not.
- Rehearsals stay on Sunday afternoons.
